{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Daniel Gisriel Rider, Jr.''' (23 July 23, 1938, [[Boston]] – 11 July 2008, [[Madison, Wisconsin]]) was a mathematician, specializing in harmonic analysis and Fourier analysis.<ref name=RiderObit>[http://www.cressfuneralservice.com/obituary/31690/Daniel-Rider/ Daniel Rider (1938–2008) Online Obituary - Cress Funeral and Cremation Service | Madison, Wisconsin]</ref>

After spending his childhood in New England, Daniel Rider moved with his family to [[Santa Ana, California]], where he graduated from secondary school. He received his bachelor's degree from [[Stanford University]] and in 1964 his PhD under [[Walter Rudin]] from the [[University of Wisconsin, Madison]] with thesis ''Gap Series, and Measures of Spheres''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=8439}}</ref> Rider was a [[C.L.E. Moore instructor]] at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] and then an assistant professor at [[Yale University]].<ref name=RiderObit/> At the University of Wisconsin, Madison he was an associate professor of mathematics from 1968 to 1971 and then a full professor from 1971 until his retirement as professor emeritus in 2003.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.math.wisc.edu/oldnews/2004/facdinner.htm |title=Six Retirees Feted at Faculty and Staff Dinner, 2004 Van Vleck Notes |access-date=2016-07-03 |archive-date=2016-08-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160820063412/http://www.math.wisc.edu/oldnews/2004/facdinner.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[https://www.math.wisc.edu/in-memoriam in Memoriam | Department of Mathematics, U. of Wisconsin, Madison]</ref> He was a Sloan fellow from 1969 to 1971. In 1970 he was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in Nice.

==Selected publications==
*with Alessandro Figà-Talamanca: {{cite journal|title=A theorem of Littlewood and lacunary series for compact groups|journal=Pacific Journal of Mathematics|volume=16|issue=3|year=1966|pages=505–514|doi=10.2140/pjm.1966.16.505|doi-access=free|last1=Figà-Talamanca|first1=Alessandro|last2=Rider|first2=Daniel}}
*A relation between a theorem of Bohr and Sidon sets. Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. 72 (1966) 558–561. {{MR|0192282}}
*Central idempotents in group algebras. Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. 72 (1966) 1000–1002. {{MR|0200744}}
*Translation-invariant Dirichlet algebras on compact groups. Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 17 (1966) 977–983. {{MR|0198140}}
*Functions which operate in the Fourier algebra of a compact group. Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 28 (1971) 525–530. {{MR|0276792}}
*{{cite journal|title=Central lacunary sets|journal=Monatshefte für Mathematik|volume=76|issue=4|year=1972|pages=328–338|doi=10.1007/BF01297366|last1=Rider|first1=Daniel|s2cid=123644292}}
*Central idempotent measures on compact groups. Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 186 (1973) 459–479. {{MR|0340961}}
*Randomly continuous functions and Sidon sets. Duke Math. J. 42, no. 4 (1975): 759–764. {{MR|0387965}}
